
`
### Macrophage extraction

```{r}
combined <- readRDS("../results/RDS/combined.rds")

macro <- subset(combined, my_annotation == "Macrophage")

macro$old_clusters <- macro$seurat_clusters

macro$condition <- as.character(macro$condition)
macro$condition[macro$condition == "cirrhosis"] <- "Cirrhosis"

Idents(macro) <- "condition" 

gc()
```

### M1M2 đã làm 

```{r}
m1_genes <- list(c("CD86", "CD80", "HLA-DRA",  "TLR2", "TLR4", "NOS2")) 
m2_genes <- list(c("CD163","MRC1", "RETN", "CLEC7A","ARG1", "CD200R1", "CD209")) 

macro <- AddModuleScore(macro, features = m1_genes, name = "M1_Score")
macro <- AddModuleScore(macro, features = m2_genes, name = "M2_Score")

colnames(macro@meta.data)[colnames(macro@meta.data) == "M1_Score1"] <- "M1_Score"
colnames(macro@meta.data)[colnames(macro@meta.data) == "M2_Score1"] <- "M2_Score"
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)

macro$condition <- factor(macro$condition, levels = c("HBV", "Cirrhosis", "HCC")) 

p1 <- ggplot(macro@meta.data, aes(condition, M1_Score, fill = condition)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, fill = "white", color = "black", outlier.shape = NA) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(HBV = "#B30600", Cirrhosis = "#2347BD", HCC = "#29AF34")) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(title = "M1 scores in Macrophages", x = "Stages of Liver Disease", y = "M1 score", fill = "group") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5), 
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12), 
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  
  stat_compare_means(
    comparisons = list(c("HBV", "Cirrhosis"), c("Cirrhosis", "HCC"), c("HBV", "HCC")), 
    method = "wilcox.test", label = "p.signif", hide.ns = FALSE, label.y = c(1.10, 1.25, 1.40))

p2 <- ggplot(macro@meta.data, aes(condition, M2_Score, fill = condition)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, fill = "white", color = "black", outlier.shape = NA) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(HBV = "#B30600", Cirrhosis = "#2347BD", HCC = "#29AF34")) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(title = "M2 scores in Macrophages", x = "Stages of Liver Disease", y = "M2 score", fill = "group") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5), 
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12), 
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11)
  ) +
  stat_compare_means(
    comparisons = list(c("HBV", "Cirrhosis"), c("Cirrhosis", "HCC"), c("HBV", "HCC")), 
    method = "wilcox.test", label = "p.signif", hide.ns = FALSE, label.y = c(1.10, 1.25, 1.40))

pp <- p1 +p2
pp

ggsave("../results/pictures/Fig S2.png", pp, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
macro_degs <- FindMarkers(
  macro , 
  ident.1 = "Cirrhosis", 
  ident.2 = "HCC", 
  min.pct = 0.25,
  logfc.threshold = 0.25,
  test.use        = "wilcox",
  only.pos = FALSE 
)
```

### GO/KEGG
```{r}
# ### Fig 1 D  ## downregulated in Cirrhosis = upregulated in HCC
# rank_degs <- macro_degs %>%
#   filter(avg_log2FC < (-0.25), p_val_adj < 0.01 & pct.1 < 0.5, pct.2 > 0.25)

# ### Fig 1 C   ## upregulated in Cirrhosis
rank_degs <- macro_degs %>%
  filter(avg_log2FC >0.25, p_val_adj < 0.01 & pct.1 > 0.25,  pct.2 < 0.50)

bg_genes <- rownames(macro)

counts_matrix <- Seurat::GetAssayData(macro, layer = "counts")

bg_genes <- rownames(counts_matrix[Matrix::rowSums(counts_matrix > 0) >= 3, ])

rank_degs$cluster <- "Macrophage"

BP <- run_enrichment(rank_degs, type = "GO", ontology = "BP", universe_genes = bg_genes)
#MF <- run_enrichment(rank_degs, type = "GO", ontology = "MF", universe_genes = bg_genes)
#CC <- run_enrichment(rank_degs, type = "GO", ontology = "CC", universe_genes = bg_genes)
#KEGG <- run_enrichment(rank_degs, type = "KEGG", universe_genes = bg_genes)

#save(BP, MF, CC, KEGG, bg_genes, file = "../results/GOKEGG_macro_3.RData" )

processed_df <- BP %>%
  filter(p.adjust < 0.05) %>%
  mutate(GeneRatio_num = sapply(GeneRatio, function(x) eval(parse(text = x))))

top_macro <- processed_df %>%
  filter(cluster == "Macrophage") %>% 
  arrange(desc(GeneRatio_num))

 top15_macro <- top_macro  %>%
    filter(Description != "muscle structure development") %>%
    slice_head(n = 15)

# TOP 10
top10_macro <- top_macro  %>%
   slice_head(n = 10)

top10_macro <- top10_macro %>%
  mutate(Description = str_wrap(Description, width = 45))

description_order <- top10_macro %>%
  arrange(GeneRatio_num) %>% # arange(tăng dần), arange(desc(giảm gẫn))
  pull(Description) %>%
  unique()

top10_macro$Description <- factor(top10_macro$Description, levels = description_order)

# DOTPLOT
p_macro <- ggplot(top10_macro, aes(x = GeneRatio_num, y = Description)) +

  geom_point(
    aes(size = Count, fill = -log10(p.adjust)), 
    shape = 21,        
    color = "black",    
    stroke = 0.8       
  ) +
  # Thang màu cho ruột (fill)
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "magma", direction = 1) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(4, 9)) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  guides( fill = guide_colorbar(order = 1), size = guide_legend(order = 2)
  ) +          
  labs(
    title = "Top 10 Enriched GO Terms: Macrophages",
    x = "Gene Ratio",
    y = "GO Term (Biological Process)",
    color = "-log10(adj.p)", size = "Gene Count"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11, color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey92", linetype = "dashed")
  )

# 
print(p_macro)

ggsave( "../results/pictures/Fig 2C.png", 
  plot = p_macro, width = 9.5, height = 6.5, dpi = 300)
```
